name: IFE Elevators Co., Ltd.
summary: IFE Elevators Co., Ltd. engages in the design, research, manufacturing, sale of elevators, escalators, moving walkways, and related products in China and internationally. The company offers passenger elevators, such as machine room and roomless passenger, panoramic, high speed, hospital, and firefighter; freight elevators, including machine room and roomless freight elevators, and high-speed freight elevators; and escalators comprising commercial, public transport, and heavy-duty public transport.
